doc.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023

title: Hillsdale College atmosphere and leadership
summary: Radke and Rowe talk about the positive student life at Hillsdale and president Larry Arnn.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: I sense that as well. And I was at the dining hall myself and there was a table behind me of fellas, they could have been on the football team if they have one.
All of a sudden they broke into a piece from an opera. They were singing opera. Not well but with such joy and verve that I said what a nice thing to hear in the dining hall.

Yeah sure, no I’m telling you. You know I was involved with the University of Washington for you know some years, and then compared to this? Well you’re involved with a university you know. It’s just a positive — everybody’s here because they want to be here. It’s not because Mommy and Daddy is sending them to school to learn how to drink beer. You know they’re here because they want to learn and they want to learn positive life values. And that comes from the leadership too, because the leadership of this school is something else. And Dr. Arnn — Larry — is just an incredible — I don’t know if you’ve met him but he’s a pretty incredible man. He’s a very positive person. And that’s what he portrays in this place. And just good people. Enjoyable to be here. And Chris is great too, our jazz guy.
